invalid_input: Something in the details isn't right. Check them and try again.
idempotency_conflict: This was already sent with different details. Refresh the screen and start again.
forbidden: This can't be done from here. If you're at the till, ask your store manager for help.
store_inactive: This store isn't live on {programName} yet. Let your store manager or HQ know.
employee_not_found: We can't find you on this store's staff list. Pick your name again or ask your store manager.
employee_required: Undo needs your PIN. Pick your name and type it in.
bad_pin: Wrong PIN. Try again. If you've forgotten it, your store manager can set a new one.
pin_locked: Too many wrong tries, so this PIN is locked for {minutes} minutes. Wait a bit, or ask your store manager for help.
brand_not_found: We couldn't find the programme. Scan the QR at the counter again or open {clubUrl}.
store_not_found: This store QR isn't working. Join at {clubUrl} instead, or ask us at the counter.
referral_not_found: We can't find that invite code. Check it, or remove it to carry on without one.
email_taken: This email already belongs to a member. Sign in with it, or use a different one.
phone_taken: This mobile number already belongs to a member. Sign in with it, or use a different one.
member_deleted: This account has been deleted, so it can't collect points or redeem rewards. Joining again starts from scratch at {clubUrl}.
member_not_found: We can't find this member. Check the code, or ask them to reopen their card and scan again.
invalid_token: That's not a {programName} code. Ask for the member card in the app or Wallet.
expired_token: That code has changed. Ask for the live card, not a screenshot, and scan again. If it keeps happening, their phone's clock may be off.
old_pass: This is an old Wallet card and it no longer works. Ask for the card in the app or the new Wallet card.
amount_not_integer: We can't read that amount. Type it in euros and cents, e.g. 6.40.
amount_not_positive: The amount has to be more than €0.
amount_over_limit: That's over the {maxAmount} limit per receipt. Check the receipt and, if it's right, tell your store manager.
amount_too_small: That amount is too small to earn points. Check you typed it correctly.
too_soon_after_last_earn: Points were just added to this card. Wait {minutes} minutes or, if it was a mistake, undo it and enter it again.
daily_earn_limit_reached: This card has reached today's limit of {maxEarns} purchases. Points can be added again tomorrow.
receipt_already_used: This receipt has already earned points at this store today. Check the receipt number.
not_found: We can't find that. If it's a reward code, check the 8 characters and try again.
not_undoable: Only points from a purchase can be undone. For anything else, tell your store manager.
already_undone: This one has already been undone. Nothing else to do.
undo_window_passed: It's been more than {minutes} minutes, so only your store manager can undo this now.
reward_not_found: This reward isn't around any more. Pick another one.
reward_unavailable: This reward isn't available right now. Pick another one.
tier_too_low: This reward is for {tier} members and above. Keep collecting!
insufficient_points: You don't have enough points for this one yet. Keep collecting and it's yours.
already_used: This code has already been used, so it won't work again.
cancelled: This code was cancelled and the points went back on the card. The reward needs a new code from the app.
expired: This code has expired and the points go back on the card. The reward needs a new code from the app.
gift_not_found: We can't find this gift. Refresh the screen and try again.
gift_used: You already have a code for this gift, or you've already had it. If the code is still valid, you'll find it in Rewards.
gift_expired: This gift has expired, so it can't be redeemed any more. Keep collecting points for the next one!
pin_format: The PIN must be {minDigits}–{maxDigits} digits, numbers only.
pin_too_simple: That PIN is too easy to guess (like 1111 or 1234). Pick another one.
device_in_other_store: This till account already belongs to another store. Use a different email for this device.
last_hq_admin: There must always be at least one HQ admin. Add someone else first.
store_code_taken: There's already a store with this code. Pick another one (Latin letters, digits and dashes only).
welcome_reward: This is the welcome gift, so it can't be switched off. Ask the {programName} team to change the gift first.
not_configured: This isn't available yet. Let the team setting up {programName} know.
unauthenticated: You've been signed out. Sign in again to carry on.
internal_error: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
network_error: No internet connection. Check your Wi-Fi or mobile data and try again.
unknown: Something didn't work. Please try again.
